scope: Photographic process 3 and continuous native WB controls. Functional manual tools for requested priorities 2-4, not completion of every SF/R gate. Extended preview/memory campaign (priority 1) deferred by owner.

validation.storage_and_history: Process-3 geometry, detail and brush recipe survives undo, redo and backup restore into an empty data root without source/cache; invalid recipes do not advance history. Historical process-1/2 identity remains exact.

numeric_export_parity.note: Parity preceded the final UI gesture fixes. Canonical processing sources and all three decoder/export binaries are unchanged; final UI, surface and XPC checks use the delivered frontend.

final-cpu.scope: Native UI with isolated library and generated or explicit source; saved recipe, edited viewer/grid, optional RAW WB and Auto actions. Surface and export scope are reported separately. No universal RAW colour or physical display qualification.

final-gpu.scope: Native UI with isolated library and generated or explicit source; saved recipe, edited viewer/grid, optional RAW WB and Auto actions. Surface and export scope are reported separately. No universal RAW colour or physical display qualification.

final-raw.scope: Native UI with isolated library and generated or explicit source; saved recipe, edited viewer/grid, optional RAW WB and Auto actions. Surface and export scope are reported separately. No universal RAW colour or physical display qualification.

manual_controls.scope: Native macOS controls on generated 1024x768 Bayer DNG. Actual mouse drags, numeric WB entry, 1:1 crop, radial placement, local exposure and brush; persisted recipe read back from a stable copy of the isolated SQLite database and WAL. No display colour or real-camera qualification.

xpc.production_rejection: TrueRenderer: Il servizio non è una build di fault injection

corrected_regressions: First manual WB gesture lost widget identity when as-shot text changed.
Histogram availability or RGB-sample labels interrupted active slider gestures; explicit stable widget identities now preserve release/save.
Mask pointer input depended on an available rendered pixel and could lose motion or the release point; geometry-based input is now independent of render readiness.
A minimum 1% crop could fail validation from fp32 rounding.
Extreme residual CA could reverse a channel on tiny images; radial gain has a positive lower bound.

limitations: No R0-R4 or SF0-SF10 gate closed; assurance Standard/Reference unavailable.
Synthetic RGB and Bayer sources on macOS. No new Windows, calibrated-camera, monitor, 12/24/45 MP or physical-memory campaign.
Manual optical correction only; no automatic calibrated lens database or sensor-domain CA.
Preview filter radii and frame estimates are approximate; assess detail through native final rendering.
Initial masks: 16 groups and 512 brush points; extended combinations and retouch tools remain planned.
Selective colour samples, creative LUTs/profiles, durable presets and output sharpening remain separate increments.
Ad hoc signature is a development artifact, not a notarized release guarantee.
